chapter: Condon's, Roy Eldridge and Benny Goodman
title: Meeting Scott Hamilton at Condon's
summary: Mike Cantarino booked Vaché and Scott Hamilton together on a Sunday night, starting their long partnership.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Tell us about your association with Scott Hamilton and how that came about.

Well, I was working at Condon’s at the time and the fellow that worked the door and sort of managed the place, used to run the Half Note, Mike Cantarino was his name. And Mike was running — the Condon band worked Tuesday through Saturday, and on Sundays Mike would book another band. And Mike had heard Scott play with Hank Jones over at Michael’s Pub and thought it would be a good idea since we were more or less the same age, to put us together for a Sunday night there, which is where I met him. We’ve just continued the relationship for a long time.
